definitions.gloss: 100 points; perfect score on a test
definitions.explanation: A score of 100 on an exam or test, representing a perfect result.
Used figuratively to describe something done perfectly or someone's ideal performance or qualities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{算数|さんすう}→算数：04170_sansuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{百点|ひゃくてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I got a perfect score on the math test.

examples.japanese: {百点|ひゃくてん}⟦{満点|まんてん}→満点：03156_manten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{九十八点|きゅうじゅうはちてん}だった。
examples.english: I scored 98 on a test with a perfect score of 100.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧{百点|ひゃくてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んだ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: Our daughter brought home her first perfect score, so the whole family celebrated.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{百点|ひゃくてん}だ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{百点|ひゃくてん}⟦{満点|まんてん}→満点：03156_manten⟧だった。
examples.english: His handling of the situation was absolutely flawless.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{行楽|こうらく}→行楽：07788_kouraku⟧{日和|びより}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{百点|ひゃくてん}だ。
examples.english: Today's weather is perfect for an outing.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧ (hundred) and ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (points). While the literal meaning is simply 100 points, the word carries strong positive connotations in Japanese culture, where school tests are typically graded out of 100.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {百点|ひゃくてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to get a perfect score
- {百点|ひゃくてん}⟦{満点|まんてん}→満点：03156_manten⟧: a perfect 100 points; absolutely flawless
- {百点|ひゃくてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧: a test scored 100

USAGE:
The figurative sense is very common in casual conversation. {百点|ひゃくてん}⟦{満点|まんてん}→満点：03156_manten⟧ is a set phrase that intensifies the sense of perfection, used both literally and figuratively.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{満点|まんてん}→満点：03156_manten⟧: perfect score, full marks — more general; works with any scoring system
- ⟦{合格点|ごうかくてん}→合格点：25967_goukakuten⟧: passing grade — the minimum acceptable score
